title: Limitations on actions.
bodyText: A civil lawsuit contesting an action by the department or a county under this part or under part VIII of chapter 46 shall be filed within sixty calendar days after the date of the action.
bodyHtml: [§264-127]  Limitations on actions.  A civil lawsuit contesting an action by the department or a county under this part or under part VIII of chapter 46 shall be filed within sixty calendar days after the date of the action. [L 2004, c 155, pt of §2]
